seed.title: Welcome to openCUDA Discussions
seed.body: Use specialized categories for design, compatibility, hardware, benchmarks, development help, proposals, questions, and governance. Promote implementation-ready work with Create issue from discussion.

seed.title: Roadmap planning index
seed.body: Coordinate phase sequencing, dependencies, and cross-phase planning around docs/ROADMAP.md.

seed.title: Architecture RFC index
seed.body: RFCs identify the problem, design, alternatives, compatibility impact, and decision criteria.

seed.title: Compatibility research index
seed.body: Research native execution, lowering, substitution, CPU fallback, unsupported behavior, toolchain boundaries, legacy libraries, and future retired GPUs.

seed.title: Idea and proposal intake
seed.body: Use this category for concrete ideas that are not yet implementation-ready.

seed.title: Reference platform validation index
seed.body: Coordinate reference topology, NUMA, PCIe, P2P, ECC, bandwidth, and hardware evidence here.

seed.title: Benchmark methodology and baseline index
seed.body: Define reproducible benchmark methodology and interpret performance data here.

seed.title: Development help and build Q&A
seed.body: Ask contributor questions about languages, CMake, testing, packaging, CI, and development environments.

seed.title: openCUDA project Q&A
seed.body: Ask general questions about project behavior, design intent, documentation, and usage.

seed.title: Experiments and prototypes showcase
seed.body: Share experiments, prototypes, integrations, workloads, visualizations, and results.

seed.title: Governance and role delegation index
seed.body: Discuss governance policy, role delegation, administration, moderation, process, ownership, and cross-domain decisions here.
